_comment: Version-controlled integrity + provenance manifest for the four INT8 ASR
models shipped by the SayIt Full Offline Installer. Hashes are SHA-256 of
the exact files bundled into the installer. Build-time verification
(model_integrity.verify_bundled_models) computes the SHA-256 of each staged
file and FAILS the build on any mismatch or missing file. These hashes were
reviewed against the locally validated model artifacts and the authentic
published sources; they are never regenerated silently during a build.
The Indic hashes also match the per-file sha256 already recorded in
